name: core-reboot
purpose: Reboot the core MLAG primary at dc1, then at dc2, while measuring both sites and both DCI directions. Each reboot must leave the site streams untouched and the DCI must recover through the surviving core.

state_checks.name: All four MLAG pairs are connected with peer 1 as MLAG primary.
Every switch runs with spanning tree off.
Both members of the DCI and of each distribution-to-core trunk are in use.
Both cables of each firewall are in use in its LACP bond to the local cores.
The dc1 firewall owns the VRRP address and the dc2 firewall is backup.
Both cables of every host are eligible in its LACP bond.
